description: The negative control for saves_slots_corpus (tests/saves_slots_corpus.cpp): two cases in conformance/saves/slots.json's shape whose expectations are DELIBERATELY WRONG — one driven through saves.slots.create's resolved config, one through a saves.slots.apply run. saves_slots_corpus_negative passes only when the runner reports both as differing and the run as failed.
sources: hand-written; the right answers are core's (conformance/saves/slots.json, 'config: none stated is the defaults' and 'run: deleting an empty slot or one that does not exist is refused')

cases.name: config: expected WRONGLY to resolve no config to four slots
run: expected WRONGLY to delete an empty slot
cases.note: `steps` is written before `start` so the first difference the runner meets is the wrongly accepted delete (core refuses it: slot_empty).
